title: Two kiwis a day
armature: Two green kiwis a day are a cheap, evidence-backed fix for constipation: fiber, water and actinidin do the work, no supplements needed.

scenes.title: Two kiwis a day
scenes.narration: Did you know that eating just two kiwis a day could help you poop more regularly?

scenes.label: the research
scenes.title: Less constipation, less discomfort
scenes.narration: Research suggests that eating two green kiwis daily can help improve constipation and reduce digestive discomfort.
sources: Gearry R. et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2023: 2 green kiwifruit/day for 4 weeks increased complete spontaneous bowel movements in constipation (multicenter RCT)
Chey S.W. et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2021: kiwifruit vs prunes vs psyllium in chronic constipation

scenes.label: inside a kiwi
scenes.title: Fiber. Water. Actinidin.
scenes.narration: Kiwis contain fiber, water, and a natural enzyme called actinidin that helps break down proteins.

scenes.title: Together: healthy digestion
scenes.narration: Together, these may support healthy digestion.

scenes.title: No supplements. No routines.
scenes.narration: You don't need expensive supplements or complicated routines.

scenes.title: Two green kiwis. Daily.
scenes.narration: Just try adding two green kiwis to your daily diet.

scenes.title: Small changes. Big difference.
scenes.narration: Small changes can make a big difference.

scenes.narration: Follow Hello Nutrition AI for more science-backed nutrition tips!

sources: Gearry R., Fukudo S., Barbara G. et al. Consumption of 2 Green Kiwifruits Daily Improves Constipation and Abdominal Comfort — Results of an International Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial. Am J Gastroenterol. 2023;118(6):1058-1068.

Chey S.W., Chey W.D., Jackson K., Eswaran S. Exploratory Comparative Effectiveness Trial of Green Kiwifruit, Psyllium, or Prunes in US Patients With Chronic Constipation. Am J Gastroenterol. 2021;116(6):1304-1312.
Actinidin: cysteine protease of Actinidia deliciosa that aids gastric protein digestion (Kaur L. et al., J Agric Food Chem 2010).
